title: The next war will be won on supply lines. Rune's AI agent is already there | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies featured in Business Insider for supply tracking innovations.
body_markdown:
# Business Insider Coverage


Rune Technologies has been featured in a recent Business Insider article discussing the Army's push to implement real-time supply tracking. The article highlights the importance of innovative logistics solutions in modern military operations.


> "Real-time tracking is crucial for operational success," stated a Rune Technologies official in the article.


This media coverage underscores the growing recognition of advanced logistics technologies in the defense sector.
